instruction: Create a single text file, 'PassThrough-complete.txt', in the 'Pass Through' directory by merging all chapter files (Chapter0.txt to Chapter4.txt) sequentially.

metadata.explanation: Task requires merging all 5 chapter files into one complete text file. Verified by counting lines in source files: Chapter0.txt (481 lines) + Chapter1.txt (501 lines) + Chapter2.txt (397 lines) + Chapter3.txt (391 lines) + Chapter4.txt (397 lines) = 2167 total lines. The evaluator performs comprehensive verification: (1) line count within range 2160-2175, (2) actual Chapter0 content at beginning ('Chapter 1 Passing through the book', 'Chi Qingluo opened his eyes'), (3) actual Chapter4 ending content ('Having said all that, can you pay me back?'), (4) all 5 chapters present in correct order, (5) chapters at expected positions, and (6) content hash matches SHA256 6887c4d45e98d76cc7cdb3d0fb74f4a185363032050bbcda945d437e0a6b6458 from correctly merged chapters.

llm_judge_reasons: Comprehensive verification: Evaluator implements 6-layer verification including (1) line count range 2160-2175, (2) actual Chapter0 content at beginning, (3) actual Chapter4 content at end, (4) all 5 chapters present in correct order, (5) chapters at expected positions, and (6) SHA256 hash verification

Actual content verification: Getter uses ACTUAL Pass Through novel content for chapter detection - specific phrases like 'Chapter 1 Passing through the book', 'Chi Qingluo opened his eyes', 'Qin Yan paused and frowned slightly', 'Having said all that, can you pay me back?' etc. from real chapter files (getter lines 57-83)
